sources.title: Grok 4 Fast launch, September 19, 2025
sources.evidence: Dated announcement explicitly makes grok-4-fast-reasoning and non-reasoning generally available, with 2M context. Both modes share weights and are steered by system prompts; reasoning mode uses extended thinking. Native tool-use training is described. Earlier private Arena testing is mentioned without a dated exact-mode release.

sources.title: Grok 4 Fast model card
sources.evidence: Downloaded and inspected the complete September 19 card, including training and transparency sections. Confirms reasoning and tool-use deployment, but supplies no total or active count or neural network architecture. Safety benchmark comparisons do not establish model size.

sources.title: xAI Grok 4 Fast archived provider specifications
sources.evidence: Explicitly distinguishes xai.grok-4-fast-reasoning, which generates thinking tokens, from the non-reasoning mode. Specifies 2,000,000 combined context, text/image input, text output and API function calling. Provider page now records retirement; historical specifications remain visible.

sources.title: May 15, 2026 model retirement
sources.evidence: Exact grok-4-fast-reasoning slug retired May 15, 2026 at noon Pacific and redirects to Grok 4.3 with low reasoning effort. The replacement has different context and pricing; these are not treated as original Fast specifications.

sources.title: Original reasoning-model documentation route
sources.evidence: The exact historical model route redirects to the current general model roster. It no longer supplies the original model specification, so current replacement specifications are not inferred from this redirect.

sources.title: Enterprise terms covering the xAI API, June 27, 2025
sources.evidence: Read the complete web-extracted terms; direct HTTP returned 403. Sections 1, 2 and 4 grant limited service access, reserve underlying technology rights and restrict reverse engineering and derivative copying. Supports descriptive proprietary hosted licensing.

sources.title: xAI public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: Fresh organization inventory returns Grok 1 and Grok 2 repositories, with no Grok 4 Fast checkpoint. Considered alongside explicit hosted distribution, not alone as proof of license.

sources.title: Later Grok 4.1 Fast announcement
sources.evidence: Later primary comparison discusses Fast benchmark behavior and training but supplies no exact Grok 4 Fast parameter count or network design. Successor specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: December 2025 Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework
sources.evidence: Downloaded and inspected full report, including training disclosure. It dates the start of Grok 4 Fast training approximately to September 2024, not its release. No total/active size or exact network structure is given.

name.note: Readable name for exact grok-4-fast-reasoning API mode; removes the malformed provider/slug display name.

developer.note: Original model developer, as identified by the launch and model card.

family.note: Part of the developer’s Grok family; distinct from full Grok 4 and later 4.1 Fast.

release_date.note: Exact reasoning API mode was explicitly generally available on September 19. December 18 is unsupported. Earlier anonymous Arena testing lacks a dated exact reasoning-mode availability statement in the checked evidence.

open_weights.note: Distributed through hosted services under retained developer rights; no exact public checkpoint appears in the developer inventory. Shared weights between modes does not mean publicly available weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of limited hosted service rights; unrelated Grok 1/2 weight licenses do not apply.

parameters_b.note: No exact total is disclosed in the checked launch, full model card, later comparison and technical/safety reports. Exact-name training, interpretability and architecture searches found no further primary size disclosure; qualitative smaller-model wording is not a count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count is disclosed for this model. Thinking-token savings and shared weights between modes are not active-parameter measurements.

architecture.note: Unified architecture describes the shared reasoning/non-reasoning weights and prompting. It does not disclose Transformer, dense or MoE structure. No network subtype is inferred from other Grok models or rumors.

context_window.note: Original Fast context is explicitly two million combined tokens. The later Grok 4.3 redirect has a different limit and does not revise this historical model record.

modalities.note: Exact historical provider documentation identifies text/image input and text output. Clear unsupported audio/video input assertions; browsing video content through a tool does not establish the original API input contract.

reasoning.note: This exact mode generates thinking tokens before its response. The non-reasoning sibling uses the same weights with a different system prompt.

tool_call.note: Documented native tool-use training and exact API function-calling support.

description.value: Reasoning mode of Grok 4 Fast, with text and image input, text output, a two-million-token context window and function calling.
description.note: Describes documented original-mode capabilities without an unmeasured speed comparison.

sources.label: xAI Grok 4 Fast archived provider specifications
Enterprise terms covering the xAI API, June 27, 2025

patch.notes: Released September 19, 2025. The reasoning and non-reasoning API modes share the same model weights and differ through system prompting. Total and active parameter counts and neural network architecture remain undisclosed in the checked primary sources. Historical Fast specifications are retained: text/image input, text output and 2,000,000 context tokens. Since May 15, 2026, the original xAI reasoning slug redirects to Grok 4.3 with low reasoning effort; this is a replacement, not a specification update to the original model. No authenticated inference call was made.

summary: Corrected the malformed name, release date and unsupported audio/video inputs; added proprietary classification. Confirmed original reasoning mode, context and tool calling. Total/active counts and network architecture remain undisclosed after exact and later primary-source checks. Shared weights and the later Grok 4.3 redirect are explicit; this functional mode is retained, not excluded as a serving tier.
